Answer: **Clothing (8–14°C, rain likely Saturday)**
- 1 spare base layer top (merino or synthetic)
- 1 mid-layer fleece or light insulated jacket
- 1 waterproof rain jacket
- 1 pair of walking trousers + 1 spare pair (or shorts)
- 1 warm hat + 1 pair of gloves
- 2 pairs hiking socks + 1 spare
- Underwear for the weekend
- 1 pair of camp shoes/sandals
- Dry sleep layer (kept in a dry bag)

- 2x dehydrated meals or similar one-pot dinners (e.g. couscous/noodle pouches)
- 2x instant porridge sachets or muesli + powdered milk
- Bread/wrap + cheese + salami for lunches/snacks
- Trail mix, chocolate bars, 3–4 energy bars
- Tea bags/coffee sachets + sugar/salt sachets
- ~3 litres of water capacity (bottles or bladder)

- Small stove + gas canister + lighter/matches
- Small pot with lid + spork + mug
- Small bottle of washing-up liquid + sponge
- Food bag + rubbish bag

**Small kit**
- First aid kit (plasters, blister patches, painkillers)
- Headtorch + spare batteries
- Phone + power bank + charging cable
- Map of the Tarnwood Hills + compass (or offline map downloaded)
- Water purification tablets (optional)
- Toilet paper + trowel + hand sanitiser
- Sunscreen + lip balm + insect repellent
- Whistle
- Small repair kit (duct tape, cord)

- Dry bags or bin liners to keep kit dry
- Sleeping mat (if not already with your sleeping bag kit)

- Lightweight camp towel

Eleanor

**Clothing & layers**
- 2× T-shirts, 1 long-sleeve base layer
- 1 fleece or midlayer
- Waterproof rain jacket (+ rain trousers if you have them)
- 1 pair hiking trousers, 1 spare pair of socks, spare underwear
- Warm hat and light gloves (cool evenings at 8°C)
- Camp shoes or sandals, small towel

**Food**
- 2× dinners: e.g. two dehydrated meals, or pasta/couscous + sauce + sausage/cheese
- 2× breakfasts: porridge sachets or muesli + powdered milk
- Lunches + snacks: bread/wraps, cheese, nuts, 2–3 cereal bars, chocolate
- Coffee/tea sachets, sugar
- Water: 2 L bottles + purification tablets or filter if refilling on trail

**Cooking & kit**
- Small stove + gas canister, lighter + matches
- Pot, mug, spork, small knife
- Biodegradable soap, sponge

**Small kit**
- First aid kit (blister plasters essential)
- Headtorch + spare batteries
- Phone + power bank, map of the Tarnwood Hills, compass
- Toilet paper + trowel + hand sanitiser
- Rubbish bag, dry bag for electronics
- Sunscreen, lip balm, insect repellent
- Cash/card, ID

Note: Pack spare socks and the rain jacket where you can reach them quickly — Saturday rain plus 8°C gets cold fast.

Clothing (cool, wet-risk: 8–14 °C)
- 2 base-layer tops (one merino/synthetic, not cotton)
- 1 fleece or light insulated mid-layer
- 1 waterproof jacket (hood)
- 1 pair waterproof overtrousers
- 2 pairs hiking trousers/leggings (one to hike in, one spare/dry)
- 3 pairs hiking socks + 1 pair sleep socks
- 3 pairs underwear
- Warm hat and light gloves
- Sun hat or cap
- Camp shoes/sandals
- Dry bag or bin liner for wet clothes

Sleep & shelter extras
- Sleeping mat
- Headtorch + spare batteries
- Small pillow or stuff sack for clothes
- Tent footprint/groundsheet (optional)

Cooking & water
- Stove + fuel canister (1 small is enough for 2 nights)
- Lighter + backup matches
- Pot, spoon/spork, mug
- 2 L water capacity (bottles/bladder)
- Water filter or purification tablets
- Small sponge/cloth + tiny soap for washing up
- Rubbish bag (pack everything out)

Food (one person, 2 dinners, 2 breakfasts, trail snacks)
- Dinner 1: dehydrated meal or pasta + sauce sachet + cheese

- Breakfast 1: instant oats x2 sachets + nuts/dried fruit
- Breakfast 2: granola + milk powder, or oats again
- 4 tea/coffee sachets + sugar/milk powder
- Trail snacks: 4–6 bars, trail mix (~200 g), chocolate, 2 wraps + peanut butter for Saturday lunch
- Electrolyte tabs (optional)
- Small salt/pepper + olive oil mini bottle

Navigation & safety
- Map of Tarnwood Hills + compass
- Phone + power bank + cable
- Offline map/route downloaded
- Whistle
- First aid kit (plasters, blister pads, tape, painkillers, antiseptic wipes, any personal meds)
- Emergency bivvy/foil blanket
- Multitool or small knife
- Duct tape (wrapped round a pole/bottle)
- Paracord (a few metres)

Toiletries & personal
- Toothbrush + travel toothpaste
- Toilet paper + trowel + hand sanitiser
- Sunscreen + lip balm
- Insect repellent
- Small microfibre towel
- Trekking poles (optional)
- Sunglasses
- ID, cash/card, car/house keys

Note: Pack the waterproofs and a dry layer somewhere reachable Saturday, and check the forecast again before you leave Friday.

Answer: 
**Clothing**
- 2 spare t-shirts
- 1 long-sleeve base layer
- 1 fleece or warm mid-layer
- 1 waterproof rain jacket
- 1 pair of walking trousers + 1 spare pair (or shorts)
- 3 pairs of hiking socks, 2 pairs of underwear
- Warm hat and light gloves (for 8°C nights)
- Camp shoes or sandals
- Pack towel and quick-dry camp clothes for sleeping

**Food**
Dinners (2): 2 dehydrated meals or couscous/pasta-and-sauce kits, plus a sausage/cheese pouch
Breakfasts (2): 2 porridge sachets + muesli bars, coffee/tea sachets, powdered milk
Extras: trail mix, chocolate, 1 spare energy bar, salt/pepper sachet, small bottle of cooking oil if needed

**Cooking & water**
- Stove + gas canister + lighter/matches
- Small pot, spork, mug, folding knife
- 2 water bottles or 2L bladder, water filter or purification tablets

**Camping extras**
- Sleeping mat, tent footprint/groundsheet
- Headtorch + spare batteries
- Small camping stool or sit mat (optional)

**Kit & sundries**
- Backpack (45–60 L) + waterproof liner or dry bags
- First aid kit, blister plasters, sunscreen, lip balm, insect repellent
- Toilet paper + trowel, hand sanitiser, biodegradable soap
- Phone, power bank, cable; map of the Tarnwood Hills + compass
- Rain cover for pack; rubbish bag; cash/card; ID

Note: With 8°C nights and rain likely Saturday, keep the fleece and rain jacket accessible rather than buried at the bottom of your pack.

Answer:
Subject: Thank you for Book Week

Dear Mrs Adebiyi, Mr Kwan, Miss Torres and Mr Fenwick,

I just wanted to say a heartfelt thank you for giving your time to our Book Week sessions on Tuesday and Thursday last week. Between the four of you, you covered twelve classes, and 38 children stood up and read aloud — many of them for the first time in front of others. That took real courage on their part, and it was your patience and warmth that made it possible.

The children (and the teachers!) got so much out of having you with us. It's hard to overstate what a difference it makes to a young reader to have a kind, attentive listener.

Thank you again — we'd love to have you back any time.

With warm regards,
Eleanor, Year 5 coordinator

Answer: 

**Clothing**
- 2 T-shirts (1 spare)
- 1 long-sleeve base layer
- 1 fleece or midlayer
- 1 waterproof rain jacket
- 1 pair of hiking trousers (wearing) + 1 spare or shorts
- 3 pairs of hiking socks
- Underwear ×3
- Beanie and light gloves (cool evenings, 8°C)
- Camp shoes or sandals
- Rain cover or dry bag for pack

**Food**
- Friday dinner: dehydrated meal or pasta + sauce (1 serving)
- Saturday dinner: dehydrated meal or couscous + sausage/cheese (1 serving)
- Saturday + Sunday breakfast: instant porridge or muesli ×2
- Lunches/snacks: bread/wraps, cheese, nuts, 2–3 cereal bars, chocolate, dried fruit
- Coffee/tea sachets, powdered milk if wanted
- Extra snack for Sunday

**Cooking & water**
- Small stove + gas canister
- Lighter/matches
- Pot + spork + mug
- Water bottles or bladder (2 L capacity)
- Water filter or purification tablets
- Small sponge + tiny bottle of washing-up liquid
- Rubbish bag

**Camping extras**
- Sleeping mat
- Headlamp + spare batteries
- Tent footprint or groundsheet (optional)

**Small kit**
- First aid kit (blister plasters essential)
- Map of the Tarnwood Hills + compass (or offline map on phone)
- Fully charged phone + power bank
- Sunscreen + lip balm
- Insect repellent
- Toilet paper + trowel + hand sanitiser
- Whistle
- Duct tape or repair patch
- Cash/card + ID
- Toothbrush + toothpaste + wet wipes

Note: With rain likely Saturday, pack the spare clothes in a dry bag so you always have something dry for camp.

Answer:

**Clothing**
- 2 × base layer tops (merino or synthetic, one for hiking, one for camp/sleeping)
- 1 × mid-layer fleece
- 1 × insulated jacket (light down or synthetic, for evenings)
- 1 × waterproof shell jacket
- 1 × waterproof overtrousers
- 2 × hiking trousers or 1 × trousers + 1 × leggings for camp
- 3 × hiking socks (one spare pair kept dry)
- 2–3 × underwear
- 1 × warm hat
- 1 × light gloves
- 1 × buff or neck gaiter
- 1 × camp shoes/sandals (optional)

**Food**
- Friday dinner: pre-cooked meal in a container (pasta, rice dish) to heat up, or dehydrated meal
- Saturday dinner: dehydrated meal or instant noodles + tuna/salami pouch
- 2 × breakfasts: instant oats (2 sachets each) + powdered milk, or granola bars + milk powder
- Coffee/tea bags and sugar as preferred (4–6 servings)
- Snacks for Saturday and Sunday hiking: 4–6 bars, 200 g trail mix/nuts, 2 pieces of fruit or dried fruit, chocolate
- Lunch Saturday and Sunday: tortilla wraps + cheese + salami/hummus (keeps without a fridge)
- 2 litres water capacity (bottles or bladder) + water treatment tablets or filter
- Small bag salt/seasoning

**Cooking kit**
- Stove + gas canister (one small canister is plenty for two nights)
- Lighter + backup matches
- Pot with lid
- Spork
- Mug
- Small sponge/cloth
- Rubbish bag (pack it all out)

**Sleeping / shelter extras**
- Sleeping mat
- Headtorch + spare batteries
- Small pillow or stuff sack to fill with clothes
- Groundsheet or footprint (if your tent doesn't have one)

**Small kit**
- Map of Tarnwood Hills + compass (and offline map on phone)
- Phone + power bank + cable
- First aid kit (blister plasters, painkillers, tape, antiseptic wipes, any personal meds)
- Sunscreen and sunglasses (even at 8–14°C)
- Insect repellent
- Toothbrush, small toothpaste, biodegradable soap
- Toilet paper + trowel + hand sanitiser
- Small quick-dry towel
- Pocket knife or multitool
- Dry bags or bin liners to line pack and protect clothes/sleeping bag
- Pack cover
- Whistle
- Cash/cards, ID
- Trekking poles (optional)
- Small repair kit: duct tape wrapped round pole or bottle, cord

Note: With rain forecast Saturday, pack the spare base layer and socks in a sealed dry bag so you have a guaranteed dry set for Saturday night.

**Clothing (wear one set, pack the rest)**
- 2 base-layer tops (merino or synthetic)
- 1 fleece or mid-layer

- 1 waterproof jacket with hood
- 1 pair waterproof overtrousers
- 2 pairs hiking trousers/leggings (one spare in case of rain)
- 3 pairs hiking socks (one spare for Sunday)
- 2–3 sets underwear
- Warm hat, light gloves, buff/neck gaiter
- Camp shoes or sandals
- Sleepwear/thermal base layer for nights

**Food (1 person: 2 dinners, 2 breakfasts)**
- Fri dinner: dehydrated meal or pasta + sauce pouch + grated cheese
- Sat dinner: dehydrated meal or couscous + tuna pouch + stock cube
- Sat breakfast: porridge sachets ×2 + dried fruit
- Sun breakfast: porridge sachets ×2 or muesli + powdered milk
- Tea/coffee bags, sugar, powdered milk
- Trail snacks: nuts, bars, chocolate (≈6–8 items)
- 2 L water capacity + purification tablets or filter

**Cooking**
- Stove + 1 gas canister (100 g is enough)
- Lighter + backup matches
- Pot, spork, mug
- Small sponge/scrubber, rubbish bag

**Small kit**
- Headtorch + spare batteries
- Map, compass, phone + power bank
- First-aid kit (blister plasters, painkillers, tape, antiseptic wipes)
- Sunscreen, lip balm
- Toothbrush, toothpaste, small towel, hand sanitiser
- Toilet paper + trowel
- Knife or multitool
- Dry bags or bin liners to keep clothes and sleeping bag dry
- Whistle, small repair kit (duct tape, cord)
- Cash/ID, emergency contact details

**Clothing & layers**
- Base layers: 2 wicking t-shirts, 1 long-sleeve wicking top
- Mid layer: 1 fleece or light insulated jacket
- Outer layer: waterproof rain jacket (hood), waterproof overtrousers
- Hiking trousers ×1, plus 1 pair of shorts or spare trousers
- Hiking socks ×3 pairs (1 spare dry pair kept in a dry bag)
- Underwear ×3
- Warm hat (beanie), lightweight gloves, buff/neck gaiter
- Camp footwear: sandals or light shoes
- Sleepwear: thermal leggings and long-sleeve top (doubles as cold-night layer)

- Dinner ×2: 2 dehydrated/pouch meals (or 2 portions pasta/couscous + 2 sachets sauce + 1 small pack chorizo/cheese)

- Hot drinks: 6 tea/coffee sachets, 2 hot chocolate sachets, small sugar
- Lunch/snacks for Sat & Sun daytime: 2 wraps/bagels with fillings, 4 cereal/energy bars, trail mix (~200 g), chocolate bar, dried fruit
- Electrolyte tablets ×4
- Water: 2 L capacity (bottles/bladder) + filter or purification tablets

**Cooking kit**
- Stove + fuel canister (100–230 g)
- Lighter + waterproof matches
- Pot (750 ml–1 L), mug, spork, small knife
- Small scrubber/cloth, biodegradable soap, rubbish bag

**Sleep & shelter extras**
- Sleeping mat
- Inflatable pillow or stuff sack for clothes
- Groundsheet/footprint, spare guylines, tent repair tape

**Navigation & safety**
- Map of Tarnwood Hills + compass
- Phone (offline maps downloaded) + power bank (10,000 mAh) + cable
- Headtorch + spare batteries
- Whistle
- First aid kit: plasters, blister pads, bandage, tape, painkillers, antihistamine, tweezers, personal meds
- Emergency bivvy/foil blanket
- Duct tape (wrapped round a trekking pole or bottle)

**Personal & hygiene**
- Toothbrush, small toothpaste, deodorant
- Toilet paper + trowel + hand sanitiser
- Wet wipes (small pack), quick-dry towel
- Sunscreen, lip balm, sunglasses
- Insect repellent
- Earplugs

**Pack & misc**
- 40–50 L rucksack with rain cover
- 2–3 dry bags (clothes, sleeping bag, electronics)
- Trekking poles
- Cash/card, ID, route plan left with someone
- Ziplock bags, pen, small notebook

Note: Chance of rain means keep the spare socks, sleepwear and electronics in dry bags and the waterproofs accessible at the top of the pack.
